request.rationale: Spring-MVC discrimination: 404 'No static resource' = path absent; 405 'Request method GET is not supported' = path registered (PUT-only)

response.spring_mvc_signal: No static resource — path ABSENT from router

facts_observed.spring_mvc_note: The 'No static resource v1/...' message is the Spring-MVC routing miss — the path does not exist in the live API router, not just a resource-not-found for the clientId.
facts_observed.client_id_note: This client was previously created and deleted in iter11. Since the path is absent regardless of resource existence, the result is definitive.
facts_observed.live_says: Path entirely absent from live API router
facts_observed.mcp_tool_note: clockify_clients_update does NOT use a /archive sub-path; it PUTs to /workspaces/{wId}/clients/{clientId} with archived:true in the body. The archive semantics are via the main client PUT body field, not a sub-resource.
facts_observed.ours_spec_discrepancy: Our spec documents a separate PUT /clients/{clientId}/archive path, but live API uses the main PUT /clients/{clientId} with archived field in body

notes: Spring-MVC 'No static resource' on GET /workspaces/{wId}/clients/{clientId}/archive definitively confirms the /archive sub-path is absent from live Clockify. Archive functionality exists but is handled by the main client PUT endpoint (PUT /clients/{clientId} with {archived:true} body), not a dedicated /archive sub-path. Our spec documents this as a separate path but live contradicts — LIVE-OVERRIDE.
